walkthrough.formula: Take any model M of ∀x LessThan(x, S(x)).
walkthrough.explanation: We have not fixed the size of its domain or a numerical interpretation of its symbols.

walkthrough.formula: Let d be any object of D.
walkthrough.explanation: There is no special assumption about d. The domain may contain other objects.
The universal premise applies to d. The total function interpreting S supplies S(d); the premise puts the pair in LessThan.
Choose S(d) as the witness. The preceding step established the required instance.
The choice of d was arbitrary, so every object has a witness. That witness can depend on the object.
The argument works in every model of the premise, including infinite models. We did not enumerate its domain.
